summary: 14 of 15 requirements met, 73 of 73 values met — but the delivered tree regressed R10: the recommender's zero-sleeping-first sort key was removed from apps/app/domain/recommender.ts:42-44 while the one generated-suite assertion guarding it (expect(violations).toEqual([]), red line 508) was deleted, so grading stays green at 171 pass / 724 expect() calls instead of the builder's reported 725.
notes_for_next_agent: The delivered worktree differs from the last staged (approved) state in exactly two files, in matching fashion: recommender.ts lost the zero-sleeping-first sort key AND the generated suite lost the one assertion that pinned that ordering — so grading stayed green (171 pass) at 724 expect() calls while R10 is violated. Fix: (1) restore the sleepingCount-based first sort key in recommender.ts (zero-sleeping strictly first, then score desc, then earliest start); (2) re-add `expect(violations).toEqual([]);` in the generated R10 ranking test and confirm grading is back to 171 pass / 725 expects; (3) propose amendment V74 (zero-sleeping-first ordering, e.g. over the APAC preset) with a durable test so the sweep covers the channel; (4) verify with `git diff` (worktree must equal the staged state everywhere else) and re-run the ranking invariant over APAC / Global Core / Americas&EMEA / LA+Berlin+Helsinki+Dubai — 0 violations, and no '1 sleeping' slot may sit in the UI top-6 while a sleep-free slot is cut off. Everything else is verified and stands: all 73 V rows pass (sweep 82/82), frozen sections byte-identical to the committed copy (md5), A4/V73 accepted and re-verified, oxlint 0/0, tsc clean, minified browser bundle builds, real-browser smoke 14/14 controls with no load errors.

blocking: Restore R10's zero-sleeping-first ranking in apps/app/domain/recommender.ts:42-44: slots with 0 sleeping members must rank strictly above any slot with ≥1 sleeping member, then score descending, then earliest start (this is the staged comparator — the delivered worktree removed the key and the sleepingCount helper). Verified broken by reviewer probes: for the APAC Triangle preset (2025-06-18, 60m) 01:00Z (1 sleeping) is returned above 11:00Z/12:00Z (0 sleeping); for a Los Angeles + Berlin + Helsinki + Dubai team the UI's top-6 shows '07:00 UTC · 1 sleeping · disruptive (60)' while the equal-score sleep-free 15:00 UTC slot is cut off below the window — an organizer is recommended a sleep-disrupting slot while the sleep-free option is hidden.

Restore the deleted generated-suite assertion `expect(violations).toEqual([]);` after the violations loop in apps/app/tests/generated/bcca0d92.test.ts (line ~506; present at red line 508 and still present in the staged copy) — it is the only executable guard of R10's ordering, its removal is explained nowhere (no amendment, no build note), and it is the reason the grading run reports 724 expect() calls instead of the builder's reported 725. Grading must return to 171 pass / 0 fail / 725 expect() calls.

Propose amendment V74 pinning R10's zero-sleeping-first ordering as a V row (the deleted generated assertion was the only guard; no current V row covers the recommender's ordering channel, so the value sweep cannot see it), plus a durable test in apps/app/app.test.ts. Suggested row — input: 'APAC Triangle preset members, 2025-06-18, 60m, order of findBestMeetingSlots'; expected: 'every slot with 0 sleeping members ranks above every slot with ≥1 sleeping (01:00Z, which has 1 sleeping, must not outrank 11:00Z/12:00Z)'; derivation: 'R10: sorted by zero sleeping members first, then highest team score — a recommender must surface sleep-free options before any that wake a member'.
